name: Thunderhawk Saliva Gland
summary: Across the Barrens, greater thunderhawks yield a gland prized by Brewmaster Drohn. He needs it to recreate Chen Stormstout's fiery Trogg Ale.

sections.title: A Wild Ingredient
sections.body: Greater thunderhawks hunt across the Barrens' arid savannas. These winged serpents are known for harnessing storms, and the older, more dangerous ones produce a saliva gland charged with natural potency. Travelers keep clear of the deadly beasts, but brewmasters value the gland as a rare base for exotic drinks.

sections.title: Chen's Secret Recipes
sections.body: Brewmaster Drohn settled outside Ratchet after Chen Stormstout traveled through Kalimdor. Drohn studies the wandering brewmaster's fermentation methods and needs a fresh thunderhawk saliva gland, stormhide lightning glands, and kodo liver to brew Trogg Ale. The fiery spirit has an unmistakable kick and is meant to fortify hardy adventurers.

faq.q: Where do you find a Thunderhawk Saliva Gland?
faq.answer: Greater thunderhawks hunt across the open savannas of the Barrens, and their saliva glands are harvested there.

faq.q: What is the saliva gland used for?
aliases: what is thunderhawk saliva gland for
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn outside Ratchet needs the gland to brew Trogg Ale, a potent recipe Chen Stormstout left behind.
Brewmaster Drohn lives near Ratchet's port. He learned exotic brewing from the wandering traveler Chen Stormstout and trades powerful ales to adventurers who brave local wildlife for ingredients.
Chen Stormstout conceived Trogg Ale as a fiercely potent drink. Brewmaster Drohn makes it with a greater thunderhawk's saliva gland, lightning glands, and kodo liver.

angles.text: As a cook, you may balk at using saliva glands, but inventive brewmasters prize strange animal essences for their zest and potency.
As a member of the Horde, you can prove yourself by hunting fierce thunderhawks across the Barrens as you travel through Kalimdor.
